race.comment: ROCKNROLL TONY (2) finished third last start, beaten 18 metres at this track over 1609m. Likely to get all the favours from this nice draw. This should be an easier assignment so he is set to play a significant role. SAPPHIRESNDIAMONDS (9) drops in grade on recent attempts. Two-time winner at this circuit and distance and draws for a trail. Dangerous if she gets the gaps. HALLOWEEN (1) ran sixth last start at Penrith but is well served by the ace draw. Expecting good run. DREAM TO DANCE (3) draws well and is in the mix following a fifth at her most recent appearance here.
